_note: Events this pack adds or updates. Same conventions as docs/audio_handoff/manifest.json.

powerup.stopwatch_activate.description: Time stops: the crown clicks, ticks slow to a halt, the world winds down like tape, a glassy chord hangs in the air. Replaces the file behind powerup.stopwatch.

powerup.stopwatch_loop.description: While time is stopped: a low frozen drone, a hanging glassy shimmer, one heavy tick every 2 s. Seamless 4 s loop.

powerup.stopwatch_end.description: Time resumes: the world spins back up, the crown clicks, the ticking starts again.
